stories.title: Houthi missiles strike the presidential palace in Aden, killing two
stories.summary: At least five ballistic missiles hit the al-Maashiq Palace in Aden, the seat of the internationally recognised government of Yemen, killing two guards from the security detail of the prime minister. The attack is the latest in an escalating Houthi campaign against Saudi-linked targets in the region.

stories.title: FBI investigates letters with unknown substances sent to US election and congressional offices
stories.summary: The FBI and the US Postal Inspection Service are investigating suspicious letters mailed to state election officials and congressional offices nationwide, and Senate staff received a warning on Thursday. The mailings come weeks before the midterm elections and follow a rise in threats against election workers.

stories.title: Trump cancels livestream of Fort Hood attacker execution by firing squad
stories.summary: Trump said in a Truth Social post that the December 3 execution of Nidal Hasan by firing squad will still go ahead but will not be streamed, reversing a plan announced last week by Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth. The reversal followed bipartisan backlash and polling that showed most Americans opposed broadcasting the execution.

stories.title: Trump administration proposes rule it says would save Medicare patients $1.1 billion on drugs
stories.summary: The proposed rule would stop hospitals from charging markups on discounted drugs for Medicare patients, which the administration estimates could save consumers $1.1 billion next year. It is the latest in a series of White House drug-pricing moves.

stories.title: Bluesky expands AI-powered Attie app so anyone can build websites and games
stories.summary: Announced at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, the Attie tool from Bluesky now lets creators build websites, quizzes, games and polls for their communities. CEO Toni Schneider described it as social vibe coding as the company expands beyond its flagship app.

stories.title: AI agents are coming to Rivian vehicles
stories.summary: Rivian says it built an in-house agentic framework that routes each spoken request to a local on-vehicle model or to the cloud depending on complexity. It handles tasks such as climate control, seat warmers and news summaries.

stories.title: Google Universal Cart shopping tool launches in the US
stories.summary: Google said Universal Cart, which lets users collect and track products found across Search and in the Gemini app, is now available to US users. It is the latest push by Google to fold shopping into AI-driven search.

stories.title: Amazon Bee launches two new personal AI devices starting at $75
stories.summary: Bee unveiled the $74.99 Frontier, a wrist-worn or clipped-on recorder, and the $99.99 Eclipse, a card-sized device that attaches to a phone. Both summarise conversations and now tie into Alexa+ and Amazon shopping.

stories.title: Browns rookie Denzel Boston limited in practice with a foot injury
stories.summary: Boston, who caught three passes for 46 yards and a touchdown against the Jets, appeared on the Wednesday injury report with a foot issue but practised in a limited capacity. He looks on track to play on Sunday against Baltimore.

stories.title: Browns coordinators preview the Ravens and explain the Jets loss
stories.summary: The Cleveland coordinators met the media on Thursday ahead of the Week 6 AFC North home game against Baltimore, discussing the injury situation and what went wrong on offense against the Jets. Sunday carries the division lead.

stories.title: Browns and Ravens injury lists plus Shedeur Sanders trade chatter lead the news
stories.summary: The Thursday roundup centres on the 36 combined names on the Browns and Ravens injury reports and on speculation that Shedeur Sanders hiring an agent signals trade interest. Both teams enter Week 6 with serious health questions.

stories.title: Eleven Browns sit out the first Week 6 injury report before the Ravens game
stories.summary: The initial Week 6 report lists 11 players who did not practise on Wednesday, leaving the roster thin on both sides of the ball. Quarterback Dillon Gabriel was a full participant as he works back from a back injury.

stories.title: Three keys for Ohio State to beat Indiana in Bloomington
stories.summary: The Ohio State offensive line, again without Austin Siereveld, must protect the Julian Sayin to Jeremiah Smith connection if the Buckeyes are to win the top-five rematch of the Big Ten title game from last season. The winner takes control of the conference race.

stories.title: Columbus Dispatch writers split on the Ohio State and Indiana final score
stories.summary: Dispatch experts offered differing score predictions for the top-five showdown between No. 4 Ohio State and undefeated Indiana. It is the first top-five matchup ever played in Bloomington.

stories.title: ESPN model gives Ohio State a slim 52.1 percent edge at Indiana
stories.summary: The ESPN matchup predictor calls the game nearly a coin flip, giving Ohio State a 52.1 percent chance to end the long Indiana win streak. The Buckeyes moved up to No. 4 in the AP poll this week.

stories.title: Colapinto handed a Sepang penalty for causing the Baku pile-up
stories.summary: Stewards penalised Alpine driver Franco Colapinto for triggering the multi-car crash at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, with the sanction carried over to the next round at Sepang. The incident eliminated Pierre Gasly and Lando Norris.

stories.title: Briatore blasts Colapinto over a very poor Baku move
stories.summary: Alpine boss Flavio Briatore said he will reflect on what action is necessary after the Colapinto crash, describing the move as very poor. The incident puts the future of Colapinto at the team under renewed scrutiny.

stories.title: Norris demands a ban for Colapinto after the Azerbaijan GP crash
stories.summary: Lando Norris called for a ban after the Colapinto collision in Baku put him out of the race, an incident that also eliminated Pierre Gasly. Norris had been running in contention before the crash.

stories.title: Russell wins chaotic Azerbaijan Grand Prix ahead of Verstappen
stories.summary: George Russell took his third win of the 2026 season with a pole to flag drive in Baku, overcoming two safety cars to hold off Max Verstappen. The race was defined by a mid-race pile-up and late-race chaos.

stories.title: Two shot on South Hague Avenue, one critically injured
stories.summary: Columbus police are investigating a shooting near 843 South Hague Avenue that left two people wounded, one in critical condition and the other stable. No information on suspects has been released.

stories.title: Columbus Marathon, Blue Jackets games and concerts fill the October 15 to 18 weekend
stories.summary: The NBC4 weekend roundup highlights the Nationwide Childrens Hospital Columbus Marathon and half marathon downtown on Saturday and Sunday, plus Blue Jackets games and live concerts. Expect road closures and heavy crowds downtown.

stories.title: FBI investigating suspicious white powder mailed to the Ohio elections office
stories.summary: Ohio Secretary of State Frank LaRose said the FBI is investigating a suspicious white powder mailed to his office and told voters they can have absolute confidence in the Ohio election process. It is part of a wave of similar letters sent to election and congressional offices nationwide.

stories.title: Central Ohio cities debate Flock license plate camera usage
stories.summary: Several central Ohio communities are weighing whether to keep or expand their Flock safety cameras amid privacy concerns. The debate follows national scrutiny of the automated license plate reader network.
